pa_breakout_atr_buffer.enumeration_rule: same independent transition-event state machine as pa_breakout_exact, keyed separately for pa_breakout_atr_buffer; no cross-variant deduplication
pa_breakout_atr_buffer.initial_state_rule: initialize NOT_BEYOND_BOUNDARY at first causal eligibility for this variant; emit only on first confirmed qualifying close
pa_breakout_atr_buffer.lifecycle_identity_rule: state is scoped to the exact boundary identity and this PA7 variant; no carry to another boundary identity
pa_breakout_atr_buffer.pass_rule: bullish close >= upper + config.breakout_atr_buffer * ATR; bearish close <= lower - buffer
pa_breakout_atr_buffer.rearm_rule: a causally later eligible confirmed close that no longer satisfies this variant's BEYOND predicate returns state to NOT_BEYOND_BOUNDARY; a later crossing may emit again

pa_breakout_exact.enumeration_rule: one record only for each causal NOT_BEYOND_BOUNDARY -> BEYOND_BOUNDARY transition for the exact state key; persistent BEYOND state emits no additional records

pa_breakout_exact.lifecycle_identity_rule: state belongs only to the exact boundary identity and is never carried to a different boundary identity; lifecycle termination retires that identity's state
pa_breakout_exact.pass_rule: bullish: close > locked upper boundary; bearish: close < locked lower boundary
pa_breakout_exact.rearm_rule: after a later causally eligible confirmed closed bar does not satisfy this variant's BEYOND predicate, state is NOT_BEYOND_BOUNDARY and a subsequent qualifying confirmed close may create a new transition; no future information is used

pa_breakout_point_buffer.enumeration_rule: same independent transition-event state machine as pa_breakout_exact, keyed separately for pa_breakout_point_buffer; no cross-variant deduplication

pa_breakout_point_buffer.lifecycle_identity_rule: state is scoped to the exact boundary identity and this PA7 variant; no carry to another boundary identity

pa_breakout_point_buffer.rearm_rule: a causally later eligible confirmed close that no longer satisfies this variant's BEYOND predicate returns state to NOT_BEYOND_BOUNDARY; a later crossing may emit again

design_amendment.reason: approved correction of frozen PA7 persistent-state cardinality contradiction

global_rules: Definitions are evaluated independently; passing one never implies another passed.

Create one record for every qualifying evidence tuple unless a definition explicitly states transition-event or first-qualifying resolution; transition-event definitions emit only on their frozen causal state transition; never select a preferred object or school.
Availability equals the maximum availability of all mandatory inputs and the resolving closed bar when one is required.
Creation records are immutable; later state, contradiction and invalidation are append-only.
No future-return, MFE, MAE, PnL, profitability, entry, stop, target, size or preferred-direction field may participate in a definition.
No implicit horizon exists. Definitions requiring a later event resolve at the first qualifying later closed bar/event; if none exists before annual end they are right-censored.
All price comparisons use frozen precision and tolerance rules from FROZEN_CONFIG; equality never silently substitutes for strict inequality.
All upstream objects are read-only and retain their original IDs; Group 8 may relate them but may not rediscover or relabel them.

value_binding_requirement.rule: Any rule depending on an upstream categorical value must reference an explicit frozen binding built from the real cross-year categorical dictionary; unknown values remain raw and unclassified.
